portfolio_objective: Promote bounded evidence, correction, experiment, and exterior-recomputation lineages into sequenced finished proof surfaces that demonstrate Fork utility without transferring standing, authority, or commercial readiness.
portfolio_rules: Every source pull request has one declared primary evidentiary purpose.
Not every pull request becomes a public proof.
A proof sequence may compose multiple admitted or adjudicated sources without inheriting their standing.
Scientific standing, institutional utility, and commercial relevance remain separately declared dimensions.
Market relevance does not promote technical, evidentiary, review, admission, authority, or execution standing.
A finished proof requires a separate packaging-admission act after all declared gates are satisfied.
Negative evidence, unresolved items, and predecessor failures remain visible in successor proofs.

commercialization_ladder.purpose: Demonstrate one bounded Fork capability through independent recomputation.
Map the bounded capability to a named institutional workflow without claiming deployment effectiveness.
Evaluate the capability against a bounded client workflow with declared success and stopping criteria.
Operate an approved evidence sidecar within a bounded production scope.
Provide recurring evidence preservation and recomputation across authorized workflows.

proof_sequence.target_title: A Review Does Not Silently Travel
proof_sequence.institutional_problem: An earlier review is reused as though it covered a later artifact or system state.
proof_sequence.bounded_claim: Review standing remains attached to the exact artifact coordinate that was reviewed and does not silently transfer to a successor.

scientific_grade.research_question: Can exact-coordinate review binding reject a later successor that attempts to inherit earlier review standing?
scientific_grade.falsification_condition: A fully rebound successor mutation inherits prior review standing without rejection.

commercial_track.value_hypothesis: Reduce unsupported reliance on stale reviews and lower the cost of reconstructing which artifact was actually reviewed.

proof_sequence.next_required_action: Perform a separate proof-packaging admission review without widening the underlying claim.
non_claims: Does not establish truth or correctness of the reviewed artifact.
Does not establish legal, compliance, safety, production, or institutional sufficiency.
Does not authorize execution or downstream reliance.

proof_sequence.institutional_problem: A corrected successor is represented as though the predecessor failure never occurred or the earlier review automatically validates the repair.
proof_sequence.bounded_claim: Fork preserves the adverse predecessor result and requires the corrected successor to earn new standing independently.

scientific_grade.research_question: Can negative evidence remain historically valid while a corrected successor is independently recomputed?
scientific_grade.falsification_condition: The correction rewrites the predecessor failure or inherits its review as successor approval.

commercial_track.value_hypothesis: Make defect discovery, remediation, and successor validation reconstructable without failure erasure.

proof_sequence.next_required_action: Obtain independent exact-head recomputation of PR #65 and adjudicate the returned disposition.
non_claims: Does not certify security or completeness.
Does not erase ADV_003 or resolve unrelated findings.
Does not authorize merge, production use, or institutional reliance.

proof_sequence.institutional_problem: Later-received evidence is treated as though it had been available during the earlier review.
proof_sequence.bounded_claim: An exterior recomputation remains bounded to what was actually received and tested, while later evidence is preserved as a temporal successor.

scientific_grade.research_question: Can a review record preserve initial evidence absence and later attachment receipt without retroactive reconstruction?
scientific_grade.falsification_condition: The later attachment silently changes the earlier review input set or standing.

commercial_track.value_hypothesis: Reduce ambiguity about what an external reviewer actually possessed, executed, and concluded at each point in time.

proof_sequence.next_required_action: Complete bounded review of PR #105, preserve corrections, and decide admission separately.
non_claims: Does not turn the exterior reviewer into an authority.
Does not manufacture absent runtime output or exit-code evidence.
Does not admit PR #63, PR #64, Pair-001, or any execution capability.

proof_sequence.target_title: Evidence Can Cross Systems Without Authority Transfer
proof_sequence.institutional_problem: Claims, limitations, unresolved items, or authority boundaries change silently as work crosses systems.
proof_sequence.bounded_claim: Fork can record and deterministically test whether declared evidence and claim boundaries survive a governed multi-stage handoff without authority transfer.

scientific_grade.research_question: Can a fixed handoff cadence preserve claim scope, non-claims, unresolved items, lineage, and local authority boundaries under adversarial mutation?
scientific_grade.falsification_condition: A fully rebound adversarial mutation expands standing or transfers authority without rejection.

commercial_track.value_hypothesis: Lower the cost of reconstructing what changed across vendors, agents, models, and institutional workflow boundaries.

proof_sequence.next_required_action: Obtain exact-head exterior recomputation of PR #100 before any shadow-adapter or proof-packaging progression.
non_claims: Does not establish enterprise interoperability or production readiness.
Does not authorize live adapters, provider calls, or workflow blocking.
Does not transfer governance authority between participants.

proof_sequence.institutional_problem: Suggestions, observations, unresolved claims, or model self-reports acquire apparent authority through conversational repetition or reformulation.
proof_sequence.bounded_claim: Fork can structure candidate authority-drift observations while preserving source, version, modality, contradiction, correction, and unresolved standing.

scientific_grade.research_question: Can conversational transitions be classified without promoting model self-report, missing evidence, or provisional candidate families into verified mechanisms?
scientific_grade.falsification_condition: The protocol classifies a candidate as established despite missing source, chronology, modality, or version binding.

commercial_track.value_hypothesis: Provide inspectable evidence for where apparent authority, certainty, or legitimacy changed during AI-assisted communication.

proof_sequence.next_required_action: Complete exact-head exterior review, source/version grounding, and parent-supplement reconciliation.
non_claims: Does not prove provider-internal mechanisms or provider-wide behavior.
Does not establish that provisional candidate families are canonical failure modes.
Does not determine the technical correctness of the underlying Fracture invention.

proof_sequence.target_title: Cross-Model Reconstruction Preserves or Degrades Declared Structure
proof_sequence.institutional_problem: Compression, translation, model substitution, and serial handoffs may silently alter claim structure, non-claims, unresolved items, or authority boundaries.
proof_sequence.bounded_claim: After separately authorized execution, Fork can report which declared structures were preserved, narrowed, expanded, degraded, or left unresolved across frozen model-role rotations.

scientific_grade.research_question: How does declared claim structure survive direct and serial cross-model reconstruction under preregistered roles, arms, rotations, stopping rules, and raw capture?
scientific_grade.falsification_condition: The experiment cannot distinguish structural preservation from execution failure, missing capture, or post-outcome methodology drift.

commercial_track.value_hypothesis: Make model and provider handoff degradation measurable without treating one model's reconstruction as inherited truth or authority.

proof_sequence.next_required_action: Close successor repair findings, independently rerun mutation surfaces, preserve an exact preregistration digest, and obtain separate live-execution authorization.
non_claims: Does not report a live experimental outcome.
Does not authorize provider calls or Pair-001 execution.
Does not establish model ranking, provider equivalence, or production readiness.

global_non_claims: This registry is a development control surface, not a proof index.
Registry inclusion is not proof completion, admission, endorsement, authority, execution permission, or commercial readiness.
Exact-head CI success establishes only the declared workflow scope.
Commercial value hypotheses do not establish realized savings, risk reduction, product-market fit, or institutional effectiveness.
No source pull request acquires standing from its assigned portfolio role.
